description: This Java class implements the configuration handling for snapshot policies within a MongoDB-based persistence layer in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create configuration instances from external config files, manages snapshot interval and threshold settings, and overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultSnapshotConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that manages the configuration for snapshot handling, including interval and threshold settings, with validation and override methods.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Private static method that retrieves and validates the snapshot threshold from the provided config. Throws an error if the threshold is not positive.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Public static factory method to create a DefaultSnapshotConfig instance from a given Config object, applying fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare two DefaultSnapshotConfig objects based on interval and threshold.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() to generate a hash based on interval and threshold.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString() to produce a string representation of the configuration.
